meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 它会在主机装好 rtk 命令行工具、挂进 agent 容器,并加一个钩子:此后 Claude 每次调用 Bash,命令输出都先经 rtk 压缩再返回。原文称 git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令可省 60–90% token,且无需改 CLAUDE.md。
howto.when: 当你要求给某个 agent 组安装 rtk、或通过 /setup、/customize 等流程配置容器时触发,它会接管安装与接线,需对每个 agent 组各做一遍。

say.text: 给这个 agent 组装上 rtk
say.note: 会装二进制、加挂载并写入钩子

say.text: 检查一下容器里的 rtk 版本
say.note: 用 docker exec 验证挂载是否生效

say.text: 看看 rtk 省了多少 token
say.note: 执行 rtk gain 查看节省情况

howto.what_en: It installs the rtk CLI on the host, mounts it into an agent group's containers, and adds a PreToolUse hook so every Bash call is filtered through rtk. Dev commands report 60–90% token savings, with no CLAUDE.md changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to install rtk into an agent group or configure a container via /setup, /customize, etc. It then handles the install and wiring, repeated per group.

say_en.text: Install rtk into this agent group
say_en.note: Installs the binary, adds the mount and hook

say_en.text: Check the rtk version inside the container
say_en.note: Uses docker exec to verify the mount

say_en.text: Show how many tokens rtk saved
